checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Both closed hands stay on machine handles.
checks.feet: Left foot on a step; right ankle cuff connected to low pulley. Fixed torso, hands and support leg; cuff attachment and constant cable length checked.
checks.movement: Standing unilateral cable knee curl, left foot on step, right ankle cuff attached to a low front pulley. Hands hold frame, torso fixed, knees 180 to 80 degrees; four seconds each direction. Stack follows cable extension.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
